author: muhammad-binsalman
name: quantam-mysh-hero
description: A sleek, futuristic hero section component inspired by an AI studio landing page design. It features a dark theme with purple gradients, a badge-style tagline, bold headlines, subtitle text, dual CTA buttons, an infinite scrolling logo carousel with fade effects, and bottom navigation elements. Built responsively with Next.js and Tailwind CSS for easy integration into modern web applications. Ideal for tech or innovation-focused websites.
